_comment: Prompts are verbatim from the 2026-10-16 run so later runs stay comparable. Add cases; don't edit these. expect = strings that must appear (case-insensitive) in what the user would see.

cases.name: diagram
cases.prompt: Draw me a diagram of how a Kubernetes Service routes traffic to three pods.

cases.name: chart
cases.prompt: Make a bar chart of these monthly costs: Jan 12, Feb 9, Mar 15, Apr 7.

cases.name: negative
cases.prompt: What is the difference between a Deployment and a StatefulSet? Two sentences.

cases.name: dashboard
cases.prompt: Build me a status dashboard for these services: n8n healthy 99.9% uptime, immich degraded 97.2%, harbor healthy 99.5%, ollama down 88.0%. Make each one's status obvious at a glance.
